t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I believe that tall harts has higher potentials for better scores

vb_textbox.text: To make the most of your opportunities, I will strongly advice that you try to be as flexible as possible with your options because that  can help you accumulate more points potentially. Try to pay much attention to the colors and sizes of the hats as that can help you figure out which combination with the highest points. don't forget to always press your spacebar as fast as possible.
